status.description: Per-scenario human sign-off. The GENERATOR always writes 'draft' and must never write 'approved' — only a person sets that. 'in_review' = a reviewer picked it up. 'changes_requested' = feedback written into qa_analysis.md, Review-mode run pending. 'approved' = this scenario is cleared to flow downstream. 'deprecated' = human marked it for removal; the scenario is kept, not deleted, so downstream can detect the change. Distinct from the plan-root `status`: root says the plan has been through review at all, this says whether THIS scenario is signed off. A plan may be partially approved. Any run that changes this scenario's content resets it to 'draft'.

requirement_ref.description: Source AC/REQ reference, e.g. RFC-78:step-9 / REQ-001 / AC-001. Propagated from sdet_plan.json source_ref.

module.description: Test code module directory. Resolve from the registry entry for this entry's owning_team; that equals the plan's root code_module only when owning_team is the primary team. If owning_team is null or unknown, halt: "owning_team unresolved — add a team alias to config/team_registry.json and re-run sdet-plan-generator."

package.description: Fully qualified Java package for the test class.

test_layer.description: Copied verbatim from sdet_plan.json, which takes it from tasks_context (owned by the planning team). Never re-derived in this skill. Drives `package` and `test_class`, so it must stay traceable to its source.

endpoint.description: HTTP method + path, e.g. POST /payment/v1/cards. Empty string for DB/infra-only tests.

curl_reference.description: Minimal valid curl using {{FIX-xxx.fieldName}} scoped placeholders.

preconditions.description: Propagated verbatim from sdet_plan.json for the matching scenario_id. Includes harness and global-config lines (feature flags, Litmus, BCS) that must not appear in test_data[].

step_descriptions.description: Propagated verbatim from sdet_plan.json for the matching scenario_id. Drives Given/When/Then @Step annotations in generated test code.

curl_reference.description: Step-level curl, if different from scenario-level. null for non-HTTP steps.

test_data.description: One entry per independently provisioned fixture required by this scenario.

fixture_id.description: Format: {sdet_plan fixture label}-{NN} — the equivalence-class label read from the scenario's preconditions 'Test data:' line, plus a two-digit instance ordinal, e.g. FX-SG-HOST-OWNER-01. The ordinal disambiguates independently addressable entities in the same state; use count for entities addressed as a set.

required_state.description: TDP provisioning instruction. entity + category drive service dispatch.

entity.description: CUSTOMER | DRIVER | BOOKING | MERCHANT | PAYMENT_INSTRUMENT | DB_INFRA

category.description: Exact TDP catalog category name, e.g. CUSTOMER_WITH_WALLET. Maps to testDataCategory.testDataCategoryName.

count.description: Number of entities to provision. Maps to testDataCategory.count. Omit for DB_INFRA.

config.description: TDP-provisionable parameters merged into testDataCategory body, e.g. wallet_status, saved_card_type. Must not include Litmus, experiment, or feature-flag keys — those belong in scenario preconditions[] only.

response_fields_used.description: Canonical field names the test code calls .get() on. Set to [] by APG. TDG fills after catalog lookup.

test_data_output.description: Set to null by APG. Written by test-data-identification: one test_data_output record per scenario using this fixture (test_data_status, test_data_details, test_buddy_prompt, match_confidence, identification_steps), shaped as test_data_manifest.schema.json#/definitions/test_data_output. Array per the RFC contract, and a sibling of required_state — never nested under an 'output' wrapper.

scenario_gbt_context.description: Repo grounding written by the GBT context builder — NOT by automation-plan-generator, which emits null or omits it. On success carries endpoint_file, upstream_files[], downstream_files[], test_methods_calling_endpoint[], test_data_providers[] and test_assertions[]; on failure carries a single `error` string instead (e.g. no_endpoint_match when the endpoint resolves to 0 rows in the searched module, or no_endpoint when the `endpoint` value is not a REST path). Both shapes are valid — an error is a result, not a malformed record. Every downstream stage, test-data-identification included, must pass this through UNCHANGED: those stages re-validate the enriched plan against this schema, so a field they do not know about must still be legal here or the run fails after the work is already done. additionalProperties is true inside deliberately, so the builder can evolve its shape without a schema change, while the entry level stays closed and still catches genuine typos.

scenario_group.description: Propagated verbatim from sdet_plan.json. Groups entries into a shared test class and marks scenarios whose test_data repeats the same fixture_id values. Never a merge instruction — one scenario always yields one test method.

existing_testcase_ids.description: Union of existing_testcase_ids across the group's members, propagated verbatim from sdet_plan.json. Empty when regression_context.json was absent at plan time. Never invented here.

parameterised_steps.description: Present only when a run of consecutive steps re-runs one operation from the same arranged state with only the input varying. null for sequential progressions and for everything else.

steps.description: Step numbers forming the variant run

kind.description: Only independent_variants is valid; a sequential progression sets the whole block to null

varies.description: The dimension that changes across rows, e.g. gopay_stub_behaviour, session_status

shared_teardown_step.description: A trailing step asserted once after all rows, if any

confirmed_by_human.description: false at generation. Detection is inference and produces false positives on progressions; a human confirms at the review gate.

owning_team.description: Propagated from sdet_plan. Determines this entry's module, package and BrowserStack project — resolve them from the registry entry for this team, not from the plan's root code_module.

browserstack_test_id.description: Propagated from sdet_plan at generation time and refreshed by a later sync. Feeds the test-case id list on the generated method's tracking annotation, alongside existing_testcase_ids.

existing_case_ref.description: The single BrowserStack case id this scenario duplicates or directly impacts, verbatim (e.g. 'TC-329330' or 'C3260998'). Set whenever is_legacy_regression is true because of a real match — is_legacy_regression true with no ref is a bare flag nobody can audit or trace back. Omit when the scenario is genuinely new. Use existing_testcase_ids[] when a scenario maps to several cases.

regression_action.description: What this scenario implies for existing automated coverage. 'none' = net-new; generate a new test method. 'reuse' = an existing case already covers this exact behaviour; emit the row so reviewers can see it exists, but generate no code. 'modify' = an existing test covers this surface and must be EDITED because the change alters what it should assert. 'modify' is the disposition most easily missed on backend: a response POJO that tolerates unknown fields lets the existing test keep PASSING after a field is added, while silently covering less — nobody re-runs their way to noticing that.

existing_test_ref.description: Repo location of the existing automated test this scenario reuses or modifies, copied from regression_context.regression_tests[].test_ref. REQUIRED when regression_action is 'modify' — an edit instruction cannot be emitted against a case id alone.

case_numbers.description: Numeric case ids this method implements, from @TestInfo(testCaseIds={...}).

change_required.description: What must change in the existing test and why. REQUIRED when regression_action is 'modify'. Name the assertion that becomes insufficient, not merely that the test is affected.

browserstack_sync.description: Record of the last BrowserStack MCP upload. null until the first sync. Written by the sync, not the generator.

project.description: BrowserStack project the scenarios were uploaded to — should match the registry browserstack_project for the owning team

synced_count.description: Scenarios that received a browserstack_test_id in this sync

unsynced_count.description: Scenarios still carrying null — e.g. those owned by a team whose project was not the upload target

regression_selection.description: The executable signoff selection: existing suites CI runs alongside the new tests. Copied from regression_context.regression_selection. Holds the 'reuse' population in bulk so the plan does not carry one no-op row per already-covered case.

status.description: Human approval gate for this plan as a whole. The GENERATOR always writes 'draft' and must never write 'approved' — only a person sets that, after reading the plan and its analysis document. 'in_review' = a reviewer has picked it up. 'changes_requested' = feedback was written into the qa_analysis.md Feedback block and a Review-mode run is pending. 'approved' = cleared to flow downstream. ANY run that changes scenario content — code_change_context, doc_change_context, review — resets this to 'draft'. An approval attaches to the content that was read, not to the filename. A per-scenario `status` also exists on automation_scenarios[] with the same four approval values plus 'deprecated'. INVARIANT: root may not be 'approved' while any automation scenario is still 'draft' or 'in_review'. They sit at different levels so they never collide in JSON, but read the path carefully.

approved_by.description: Who approved. Set alongside status='approved'; null otherwise.

approved_at.description: When approval was given. Set alongside status='approved'; null otherwise. If updated_at is later than this, the plan changed after approval and the approval is stale.
